notes.title: The First Public Playtest Is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We just pushed the first public playtest build of Convergence Point — and you can try it out right now.

This build includes:

2 levels

1 boss room

Full support for keyboard/mouse and controllers 

Movement: WASD or left joystick 
possession: spacebar  or Left trigger (L2)
attacks: keyboard (I, O, P) or Controller (square, x and  right trigger (R2)



It’s still super early — there are bugs, rough edges, and probably a few crashes. But we’re really excited (and yeah, a little nervous) to finally let people see what we’ve been working on.

This is just the beginning. We’ve got more updates, improvements, and new content on the way. But for now, we’d love it if you gave the build a shot and told us what you think.

There’s a feedback form on the main menu — please use it to share your thoughts, report bugs, or just let us know what worked (or didn’t). If the game crashes, you’ll be prompted to send a report — those are super helpful too.

If you want to stay in the loop or have questions, come join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/yuuJr9zRvg]Discord[/url]. We’ll be hanging out there, sharing progress, and chatting with everyone interested.


Thanks for being here, and thanks for playing.
Excell Pepple,
Dev On Convergence Point.



Join the Discord to chat with us and stay updated:
👉 https://discord.gg/yuuJr9zRvg

🛒 Enjoyed the game? Wishlist it on Steam to support development:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559950/Convergence_Point/

Build Info
🛠️ Version: Playtest Build v0.1.0
📅 Released: [May 2, 2025]
🎮 Platform: Windows
🐞 Known Issues: Random crashes on death/level load, rare softlocks in boss room.

notes.title: Convergence Point: Play Test Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are preparing for the first ever open playtest for convergence point, right now the play test que is open for requests but at this point the build is still buggy and crashes once in a while. Once we have a stable build we will let everyone in to check out the game.

Keeping this in mind if you are one of the few people i let in already, you can find the controls bellow

Movement - WASD - Left joystick
Possession (Body Hopping) - Space Bar - Left trigger (L2)
attacks - I, O  - X, square
special (Area of effect) - P - Right trigger (R2)

use Shift + tab to open the steam overlay and close the game at anytime.

if the game crashes use the task manager to end task on the game.

We appreciate your time and patience, so let us know if you find any bugs, or have any feed back for us.

All the Best,
Excell Pepple,
Developer of Convergence Point.
